corpus.title: Enabling SQLite WAL Mode
corpus.summary: Switched SQLite database configuration to write-ahead logging (WAL) mode to resolve concurrent read lock contention.
corpus.transcript: Maya and I looked at the database locks today. SQLite in DELETE rollback mode was blocking reader threads during write checkpoints. Enabling WAL mode immediately resolved the lock contention.
action_items: Benchmark read throughput under WAL mode

corpus.title: Park Walk for Mental Recovery
corpus.summary: Took an extended walk in the city park to unwind after high-stress production deployment.
corpus.transcript: Spent an hour outdoors walking through the park. Feeling completely restored and calm after a hectic week of late-night releases.

corpus.title: Conference Paper on Local Voice AI
corpus.summary: Outlining paper structure demonstrating private, local speech-to-text and lightweight LLM organization without cloud APIs.
corpus.transcript: Drafted the introduction and system design for the conference paper. The core contribution is local execution with Whisper and 3B models keeping all audio private.

corpus.title: Refactoring Audio Pipeline Memory Leaks
corpus.summary: Investigated memory leak in audio buffer streaming; resolved by explicitly unlinking tempfiles in finally blocks.
corpus.transcript: Observed memory growing by 100MB per audio file upload. Fixed it by implementing context-managed temporary file unlinking and garbage collection.
action_items: Add automated test for orphan file cleanup
